mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName} (userId, commitDateTime, content, finishTime, comment) values (#{one.userId}, #{one.commitDateTime}, #{one.content}, #{one.finishTime}, #{one.comment});
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( `id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `userId` varchar(10) NOT NULL, `commitDateTime` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '提交时间', `commitDateTimeFormat` varchar(19) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (from_unixtime(`commitDateTime`)) VIRTUAL NOT NULL, `content` varchar(300) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, `finishTime` varchar(19) CHARACTER SET utf8 DEFAULT NULL, `comment` varchar(300) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注', PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE ) ENGINE = InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT = 239 CHARACTER SET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_general_ci ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC;
